messages:
lena.p: Postmortem follow-up: the last outage showed repeated cross-region failovers + TLS handshakes timing out after the load-balancer routing tweak. We need a compact remediation plan, owners, and short timelines.

jess.b: TL;DR: routing policy change -> some clients retried -> cross-region hops -> SNI mismatches exposed. Agree we need fixes.

lena.p: Proposed items:
1) Route pinning for critical customer routes (prevent silent region failover)
2) Add SNI & cert hostname checks to pre-deploy validation
3) Metric + alert for region_mismatch_retry_ratio > 0.8% over 5m
4) Canary TLS rolling reconfig in two regions (compare handshake_success_rate)
5) Auto-rollback controller prototype (monitor success rate delta)
6) Daily route-diff export + weekly audit

tom.r: I'll take #1 (route pinning) and #6 (route-diff export). ETA: Tue EOD. Will push a small config schema change and a migration.

jess.b: I'll do #2 and help with #4 canary tests. PR for SNI checks by Fri. Will add unit tests that validate cert hostname vs route SNI.

netops: For the alert (#3), recommend using aggregate: sum(retries by region)/sum(requests by region) to detect cross-region amplification. We can make 0.8% initial, but allow per-customer overrides.

lena.p: Good point. Make the alert tiered: warn at 0.5%, page at 1.5%. Also track which upstreams are causing cross-region hops.

dan.s: Auto-rollback (#5): I can prototype a controller that snapshots pre-change success_rate, watches 10m post-change, and reverts weights if success_rate drops > 2 percentage points. Caveat: need a cooldown + manual override.

oncall-bot: Note: create-followup 1769127890 created tasks: FOL-8895, FOL-8896, FOL-8897.

jess.b: For canary (#4) let's pick us-west-2 and eu-west-1 as canary pair. We'll run 1k requests/min for 30m and compare TLS handshake percentiles. Anyone object?

tom.r: sounds fine. Also implementing region_to_region fallback map to avoid silent failovers. I'll include that in the PR.

netops: Dashboard owners? We should surface per-route retry heatmap and cross-region edge counts. I can own the dashboard if someone supplies the exact metric names.

lena.p: Paul (cc'd earlier) had a dashboard template; jess, can you paste the metric names once PR is in?

jess.b: Sure: tls.handshake_success_rate{region,route}, request.retry_ratio{region,route}, routing.fallback_count. I'll add these to the PR description.

dan.s: One more note: avoid lowering TLS timeouts cluster-wide as mitigation. That masks issues and breaks slow clients. If we need a temporary mitigation, do per-upstream overrides in the canary.

tom.r: Agree. We'll not change global timeouts.

lena.p: Owner summary (I will paste this into the official postmortem): Tom R - route pinning + fallback map + route-diff export (Tue EOD); Jess B - SNI validation + canary tests + metrics names (Fri); Dan S - auto-rollback prototype + runbook (prototype 5 days); NetOps - dashboard & alert config (3 days).

oncall-bot: Reminder: first follow-up check-in scheduled in 7 days. Use /incidents checkin 1769127890 to report.

jess.b: I'll open the SNI validation PR today and link the canary harness.

tom.r: opened config PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4521 - includes route pin flag and export job.

dan.s: Created auto-rollback issue with draft runbook: https://issues.redwood/internal/ISS-2001. Prototype lambda will be available for testing by next Thursday.

lena.p: Perfect. Keep updates short in this thread. If anyone hits blockers, @me. We'll mark complete in the postmortem only after 30 days of stable metrics. :white_check_mark:
